2609.04947.title: MCPO: Modality-Contrastive Preference Optimization for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Compression
2609.04947.paper_summary: Recently, multimodal large-scale reasoning models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks through long Chains-of-Thought (M-CoT). However, excessively long reasoning trajectories incur substantial computational costs and significant KV-cache pressure. Existing CoT compression and alignment paradigms mainly rely on static rules or single-dimensional preferences, lacking fine-grained cross-modal constraints; as a result, they are prone to inducing visual laziness and hallucinatory reasoning. To address these issues, we propose Modality-Contrastive Preference Optimization (MCPO), a highly sample-efficient two-stage length-compression method that requires fewer than 900 training samples. In the compression stage, we introduce a step-level Normalized Cross-Modal Mutual Information (NCMI) pruning algorithm, which automatically identifies and removes visual-independent reasoning steps by comparing the reasoning discrepancies between with-image and no-image contexts. This significantly reduces redundancy and hallucinatory content in the reasoning chains. In the alignment stage, the model first undergoes supervised fine-tuning to achieve domain-adaptive initialization, followed by optimization using an asymmetric multimodal length-controlled preference loss. This objective adopts a highly nonlinear odds-ratio formulation that provides steep gradients in the with-image context to reinforce length constraints for preferred trajectories, while applying a scaled, flat-gradient linear difference in the no-image context to maintain modality consistency, thereby achieving stable cross-modal preference alignment. Extensive experiments on mainstream base models such as Qwen3-VL-Thinking show that our method can reduce CoT length by up to 69.5% and achieve up to 3.34x end-to-end inference speedup while preserving original accuracy.
2609.04947.paper_summary_zh: 最近，多模態大型推理模型在通過長期思維鏈（M-CoT）解決複雜任務方面展現了卓越的能力。<lb/>然而，過長的推理軌跡會產生可觀的計算成本和顯著的KV-cache壓力。<lb/>現有的CoT壓縮和對齊範式主要依賴靜態規則或單維偏好，缺乏細粒度的跨模態約束；因此，它們容易導致視覺懶惰和幻覺推理。<lb/>為了解決這些問題，我們提出了模態對比偏好優化（MCPO），這是一種高樣本效率的兩階段長度壓縮方法，所需的訓練樣本少於900個。<lb/>在壓縮階段，我們引入了一種步驟級別的標準化跨模態互信息（NCMI）修剪算法，通過比較有圖像和無圖像上下文之間的推理差異，自動識別並移除視覺獨立的推理步驟。<lb/>這顯著減少了推理鏈中的冗餘和幻覺內容。<lb/>在對齊階段，模型首先進行監督式微調，以實現領域自適應初始化，然後使用不對稱多模態長度控制偏損進行優化。<lb/>這一目標採用高度非線性的比值比公式，在有圖像上下文中提供陡峭的梯度，以加強對於偏好軌跡的長度約束，同時在無圖像上下文中應用縮放的平坦梯度線性差異，以保持模態一致性，從而實現穩定的跨模態偏好對齊。<lb/>在主流基礎模型如Qwen3-VL-Thinking上的大量實驗表明，我們的方法可以將CoT長度減少多達69.5%，並在保持原始準確性的同時實現高達3.34倍的端到端推理加速。
